objective: Provide conditional, capability-stratified measurements of whether a WAM's native action and predicted future are compatible, without assuming that every WAM is future-driven or conflating visual quality with action consistency.

unit_of_analysis.statistical_unit: twin or source_key, never individual intervals when branches share a source

step2_counterfactual_consistency.pair_gate: both branches must provide the required channel; otherwise pair is unavailable

step2_single_branch_alignment.warning: Frozen MAS scope is directional yaw alignment; metric distance/progress/lateral/curvature adapters remain diagnostic and do not replace metric CFAC

future_to_action.required_intervention: hold history and command fixed while perturbing future or future latent
future_to_action.claim_boundary: Delta S_F versus Delta P_A alone establishes consistency, not mediation; if the required future-only intervention is unavailable, this channel is unavailable rather than a zero score

fcs.requirement: native action evaluated by an independent simulator with explicit task labels and task-label provenance

interpretation.high_score_high_coverage: broad conditional evidence of the declared capability
interpretation.high_score_low_coverage: narrow evidence; do not generalize beyond scored units
interpretation.low_score_high_coverage: the capability was observable but inconsistent
interpretation.unavailable: no conclusion about that capability; not a zero or a failure

report_contract.composite_policy: report metric vector before considering any aggregate score

ranking_policy.reason: Consistency and grounding channels are evidence dimensions, not a calibrated total utility scale.

architecture_claim_policy.interpretation: Two formal models validate the measurement protocol on the declared models; they do not establish architecture-universal performance.

current_claim: The framework is a conditional evaluation standard: it does not assume that every WAM is future-driven. Directional-yaw MAS and RCS variants are validated on Epona and DriveWAM with source-level bootstrap gates passed, while metric magnitude/progress channels remain diagnostic. GS is formally frozen for external-future grounding. Future-to-action mediation is an optional evidence channel and remains unavailable until a four-condition, source-disjoint promotion passes; an unqualified pilot or its absence does not invalidate the other scores.
